main_menu:
📍 *Main Menu - Follow the guide below to get started:*

1️⃣ Tap *🎮 Games* to browse all 10 available multiplayer games.
2️⃣ Add this bot to any Telegram Group to start playing with friends.
3️⃣ Earn 💰 *Coins* & ⚡ *XP* by winning matches, completing daily quests, and claiming daily login rewards!

Select an option from the menu below:
game_list_title:
🎮 *Available Games List*

Click any game button below to get game-specific rules & instructions, or start a match in a group using `/newgame <game_slug>`!
no_active_session:
ℹ️ *No Active Game Session Found*

To start a game in this group, follow these 3 easy steps:

1️⃣ Type `/games` to see available games.
2️⃣ Type `/newgame <game_name>` (e.g. `/newgame tic_tac_toe`).
3️⃣ Have players type `/join` to enter the lobby!
session_conflict:
⚠️ *Active Session Already Running*

There is already an active game running in this group. Finish the current match or type `/cancel` to end it before starting a new one.
not_your_turn:
⚠️ *Wait for Your Turn!*

It is currently another player's turn. Please wait for your turn prompt.
daily_claimed:
🎁 *Daily Reward Claimed!*

Streak: 🔥 {streak} Days
Earned: +{coins} 💰 Coins!
already_claimed:
⚠️ *Already Claimed Today!*

You have already claimed your daily login reward today. Come back in {hours} hours for your next reward!
access_denied: 🚫 *Access Denied:* You do not have permission to execute this administrative command.
how_to_play_steps:
1️⃣ *Add Bot to Group*: Add @TeleGameMasterBot to any group chat.
2️⃣ *Start Lobby*: Type `/newgame tic_tac_toe` or select from `/games`.
3️⃣ *Join Lobby*: Other group members type `/join`.
4️⃣ *Play Match*: Tap the interactive inline buttons on your turn!
5️⃣ *Rank & Rewards*: Earn Elo rating, level up, and unlock titles in `/shop`!
